verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions lets developers reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions. Gitea also integrates with third-party tools such as Drone, Woodpecker, Argo CD, Jenkins, Slack and Discord through its API and webhooks. However, the evidence shows no first-party marketplace for discovering and installing apps, and no AI model extensions at all. Missing for 10: a native marketplace or app directory, AI model integrations, one-click install of third-party apps, and independent hands-on corroboration of reusing actions.
